title: Concept: Proxy bypassed for every host
description: .npmrc declares a `noproxy` value that bypasses the proxy for all hosts, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every registry request goes direct, so the inspection and caching the proxy provides are lost while the configuration still looks like it routes through one.
risk: Every registry request goes direct, so the inspection and caching the proxy provides are lost while the configuration still looks like it routes through one.
